# Mohan Car Care and Workshop

> Car service and repair workshop in Nanjikottai, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, India, near the Thanjavur New Bus Stand. 32 years of experience in the car industry. Services all major car brands sold in India and also provides acting drivers (a driver to drive the customer's own car). Rated 4.8 out of 5 on Google. Phone: 094431 75813.

- Business name: Mohan Car Care and Workshop (also known as Mohan Car Care)

## Services

- General car servicing (periodic maintenance, fluid top-ups, filter changes, multi-point check)
- Engine repair (noise, overheating, misfires, oil leaks, power loss)
- Oil change
- Brake service (pads, discs, drums, brake fluid)
- Clutch repair and replacement
- Suspension repair (shock absorbers, bushes, links)
- Wheel alignment and balancing
- Car AC service and repair (gas refilling, compressor, condenser)
- Denting and bodywork
- Car painting and polishing
- Electrical and battery work (battery replacement, wiring, lights, starter, alternator)
- Acting driver service: experienced drivers to drive the customer's own car for local trips, functions and events, hospital visits and outstation travel
